desc: Open wooden folding attic stair at a white-trimmed ceiling hatch in a modest finished room, with straight ladder sections, visible hinge hardware, a framed opening, and clear floor landing space below.
reuse_notes: Use for attic pull-down stairs, ceiling-hatch access, attic-service planning, and residential carpentry articles. It depicts a generic installed stair context, never a JK Prestige project or a substitute for confirming opening size, framing, spring adjustment, load rating, clearance, insulation, or safety requirements.
